metadata.title: Complete self-shrinkers with constant norm of the second fundamental form in \(\RR^4\)
metadata.abstract: Let \(X:M^3\to\RR^4\) be a complete self-shrinker with constant squared norm \(S\) of the second fundamental form. We prove that \(S=0\) or \(S=1\), and that \(X(M)\) is isometric to a hyperplane or a standard product \(\SSS^k(\sqrt{k})\times\RR^{3-k}\), \(1\leq k\leq3\). This proves a conjecture proposed by Cheng and Wei for three-dimensional hypersurfaces.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 证明 R⁴ 中第二基本形式平方范数恒定的完备三维自收缩超曲面仅有 S=0 或 S=1，对应超平面及标准球柱乘积。
analysis.breakthrough: 确认 Cheng–Wei 猜想的三维超曲面情形。
analysis.limitations: 结论限于三维与恒定 S，不能据此扩展到任意维或一般有界曲率自收缩子。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 平均曲率流奇点模型中的核心分类结果。
